title: Old school meets new school!!
text: Old school meets new school!!. This butterfly chair reminds me of my youth - chairs my parent(s) had when I was young. It has a black iron frame and a leather seat. It might take a few minutes for you to assemble, between the lettered parts and instructions, but once you do you will have something that resembles the old school butterfly chair. To me, this chair isn’t really all that comfortable for someone my age and size (53 with bad knees), but for a young person (teens to early 20s), it will work. With that in mind, I plan to use it as an accent piece. It would also work in an apartment, office or entry-way. I also wouldn’t recommend this chair for someone who is really tall or heavy, they wouldn’t be comfortable, although we all know that leather gets more comfortable the more it is used or worn (i.e., the longer you sit in it). And finally, there is a slight odor to the leather, but airing it out for several weeks should do the trick.
